subject: POC/Trial plan - Deployment mode decision (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-18T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: Quick follow-up & proposed POC/Trial plan (deployment mode)

Hi Alex - thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap from our side and a proposed next step:  

Summary of requirements you shared:
- Primary need: low-latency generation at scale for customer-facing features (sub-100ms p95 for short prompts).
- Data constraints: PII controls and audit logs for query provenance.
- Compliance: SOC 2 controls and contractual logging retention (7 years).
- Preference: Performance suggests Dedicated capacity, but security team asked about Private VPC/on-prem options.

Proposed short POC/trial plan (high level):
1) Objective: validate throughput/latency and data isolation model for your top-two inference flows.
2) Success criteria (we can tighten with your team):
   - p95 latency <= 120ms on target payloads (token lengths ~40-200).
   - Throughput: sustained 300 QPS on a single service endpoint for 5m windows.
   - Logs & auditing: end-to-end request logs accessible to Acme with retention policy.
3) Deployment modes to validate: Hosted API (fast iteration) -> Dedicated reserved capacity (predictable perf) -> Private VPC (if required for procurement).
4) Timeline: 3-4 weeks total: kickoff + 2 weeks baseline POC + 1 week tuning & handoff.
5) Stakeholders: Alex (product), your infra/security (procurement loop), Ben (sales), Marissa (AE), Jonas (solutions).

Can you confirm that success criteria look reasonable and who from your security/procurement team we should loop in? If you prefer, we can draft two parallel tracks (Dedicated first, Private VPC readiness as contingency). I can follow up with a concrete SOW and a kickoff agenda.

Thanks - talk soon.

- Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme-corp.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-19T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up & proposed POC/Trial plan (deployment mode)

Thanks Ben - useful recap. A few clarifications from our side:
- Performance is the top priority; we see spikes to 4-5k requests/min during peak. Dedicated capacity looks attractive for predictable latency.
- Security: our security/compliance team will want audit logs and a private network option. If Private VPC is available with the same performance profile, that would be preferred for production. For the POC, however, we are ok validating on Dedicated if it proves low-latency.
- Procurement: I will loop in our procurement lead (procurement@acme-corp.com) for any billing/SOW questions.

Next steps: please send a PoC plan with success criteria and a draft SOW + any SOC2 evidence. Also include an estimated cost delta between Dedicated vs Private VPC (ballpark).

- Alex
Alex Johnson
Senior Product Manager, Acme Corp
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-19T11:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up & proposed POC/Trial plan (deployment mode)

Great - thanks for the clarity Alex. Attached below is a concise PoC plan in-line and I'll send a formal SOW and SOC2 summary as attachments (see attachments).

PoC plan (detailed):
- Kickoff (Day 0): 60-min alignment call, confirm test payloads and access; participants: Alex, product lead, security rep, Ben, Marissa, Jonas (solutions).
- Baseline run (Days 1-7): run 2 representative workloads against Hosted API to validate functional correctness & latency profile at low load.
- Dedicated capacity run (Days 8-21): provision dedicated GPU pool configured to your expected batch/sequence mix; stress to 300 QPS sustained and short spikes to 500 QPS. Capture p50/p95/p99 latency.
- Private VPC readiness (parallel, Days 8-21): preliminary VPC network tests and eligibility assessment (if needed, we can stage this as a dry run; full Private deployment requires procurement lead time).
- Tuning & handoff (Days 22-28): apply recommended batching/quantization configs and validate success criteria.

Success criteria (repeat):
- p95 latency <= 120ms (for short prompts) during baseline and dedicated run
- Sustained throughput target met (300 QPS)
- Audit logs delivered to Acme S3 with retention policy available

Ballpark cost delta (rough, for planning):
- Hosted API: low operational overhead, metered usage (good for early tests).
- Dedicated: higher monthly commit but ~30-50% better p95 predictability for bursty workloads.
- Private VPC: additional infra and onboarding costs; useful if procurement requires network isolation and specific KMS integration.

Attachments I will send: 1) draft SOW (POC scope & pricing), 2) SOC 2 summary, 3) sample kickoff agenda.

Do you have availability for a kickoff next Tuesday or Wednesday?

- Ben

- I've attached our SOC 2 summary (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf) for your security team. Jonas will handle the Dedicated capacity provisioning and baseline performance tuning.
- For procurement: if Acme expects a Private VPC, there is usually an additional onboarding window (2-6 weeks) depending on network approvals - we can run Dedicated in parallel to avoid delays.
